name: step to the zero of the local second-order rational model
mechanism: use the value, first and second derivative at the current point to fit a hyperbola (a rational function of degree one over one) tangent to the function, and jump to its zero; the error cubes each step near a simple root

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Halley's method' in section Computational mathematics / Numerical algorithms / Root finding: uses first and second derivatives

fails_when: the second derivative is often unavailable or expensive
